pages.quiz:
AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.

3. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.

4. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.

5. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

7. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

9. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

11. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

12. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Navigation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Terminal Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Ramp services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Airfield Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.

3. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.

5. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.

6. A — Information and Communication Technology

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.

8. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.

10. B — CPU

11. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

12. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Navigation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Terminal Operations; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Ramp services; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Airfield Safety; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
